pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed stellate polygons with high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. Individual dark regions exhibit sharp projections and high perimeter-to-area ratios.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thin, light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological mesh. The network is characterized by narrow pixel thickness and a high frequency of trivalent (Y-junction) and tetravalent (X-junction) nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck, created by short, erect, densely packed bristles of the mane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a symbiotic bird (oxpecker) perched on the dorsal-cranial edge of the mane.
